description.value: Heartstrings is a sprawling 10,000-square-foot home decor, gifts, and furniture shop housed in a log-framed building in downtown Smithers, BC, founded in 2003 and recently relocated to 1207 Main Street. The store carries an eclectic mix of home accessories, pottery, jewellery, bath and body products, indigenous souvenirs, gourmet food, and freshly made in-house fudge. It is a well-established local institution offering custom gift baskets, complementary gift wrapping, and worldwide shipping.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, and the 'Groceries' category assignment is a mismatch for a gift/decor shop.
